Align coverage and fixture setup

Run pretest before coverage so the command works without previously downloaded fixtures. Upgrade to c8 12 and use it for both text and HTML reports, removing the duplicate Node.js coverage report.

Check HTTP status before saving fixtures and create the destination directory instead of retaining a placeholder. Remove the obsolete lint override for CommonJS scripts.

Declare the CommonJS package type and lint .mjs files with Node.js globals that exclude CommonJS-only bindings. Align ESLint configuration structure, npm script ordering, Git ignore patterns, and LF line endings with the other jsdom projects.

Use ci.yml with the CI workflow name, multiline YAML lists, consistent job and step names, and read-only repository permissions. Enforce dependency engines in workflow installations and explicitly test Node.js 26.0.0 alongside the existing minimum versions.

Update dependencies, including ESLint config 6.1.0, and regenerate the lockfile.
